title: HDDHub visual tuning (opacity, shadows, brightness, scale, arm angles)

requirements.text: Update the HDDHub arm rotation mapping so lane/category 1 (index 0 in frontend/src/data/categories.ts) renders at an absolute 42° rotation from horizontal and lane/category 13 (last index) renders at an absolute 20° rotation from horizontal, with linear interpolation across all lanes; keep the default/rest arm angle at the lane 1 angle when there is no hoveredCategoryId and no selectedCategoryId.

quotes: then arm limit change 20degree-13th category to 42degree-1st category.

acceptanceCriteria: With no hovered or selected category, the HDD arm renders at 42° (lane 1).
Hovering/selecting the last category maps the arm to 20°.
All intermediate lanes map linearly between 42° and 20° with no discontinuities.
No other hover/click behaviors change (hover moves arm and spins platter; click still opens the overlay and sets selected lane).

requirements.text: Apply an overall opacity of 75% to the entire HDDHub visual (body + platter + arm together), without affecting the left-side menu or the fixed VinylPlayer overlay.

quotes: reduce some brightness of platter, and then whole hard disk opacity to 75 percent. then arm limit change...

acceptanceCriteria: The HDDHub composite (body, disk, arm) renders at ~0.75 opacity as a whole.
The left-side text/menu and the top-right VinylPlayer retain their current opacity/appearance.
Hover/click interactions remain fully functional (opacity change must not disable pointer interactions).

requirements.text: Reduce the HDD platter (disk layer) brightness to improve contrast while preserving the existing disk spin animation behavior and centered rotation.
acceptanceCriteria: The disk/platter appears visibly dimmer than before (subtle darkening).
The disk still spins around its visual center with the existing animation timing/behavior.
Only the platter brightness changes; no unintended changes to the body or arm brightness.

requirements.text: Add a subtle shadow cast by the HDD arm onto the platter (shadow should visually sit between the arm and the disk layers) to better differentiate the arm from the platter.

quotes: then give sime shadows under arm to differentiate between them
1 the slight shadow of arm on platter

acceptanceCriteria: A subtle, realistic-looking shadow appears under the arm, visibly separating it from the platter.
The shadow does not create harsh edges or overpower the HDD visuals (keeps the existing restrained aesthetic).
The shadow follows the arm position/rotation (i.e., remains consistent as the arm moves between lanes).

requirements.text: Reduce the rendered size of the platter image layer by approximately 2% (relative to the current platter render size), without changing its aspect ratio (must stay 1:1) or its centered rotation behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The platter render size is ~2% smaller than the current live version.
The platter remains perfectly square (1:1) and still spins around its own visual center.
No changes to lane mapping logic or hover/click behavior are introduced by this size adjustment.

requirements.text: Reduce the entire HDDHub rendered size by approximately 25% (scale down the full HDD visualization including body, platter, and arm), while keeping it centered in the right column and preserving all layering, offsets, and interaction hit areas.

quotes: and then reduce whole image by 25%,

acceptanceCriteria: The full HDDHub visualization appears ~25% smaller than before while remaining centered in the right column.
All three layers (body/platter/arm) remain correctly aligned after scaling.
Hover and click interactions still work exactly as before (no broken hover zones or misalignment-related interaction bugs).

constraints: Frontend must not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not change VinylPlayer behavior or audio playback behavior.
Do not change category list ordering, IDs, or overlay behaviors; only apply the requested HDDHub visual and mapping adjustments.
Do not introduce new glow ring/highlight visuals (they were previously removed/disabled).
No backend changes are required for these visual/layout/mapping updates.
nonGoals: Adding new categories or changing existing category overlay content.
Changing HDDHub asset filenames or asset URL resolution/fallback behavior.
Implementing new animations beyond the requested subtle arm shadow and brightness/opacity/scale adjustments.
Any changes to the Photo Gallery backend/API or upload behavior.

preferencesToAdd: Prefer subtle, realistic HDD visuals: arm shadowing, dimmer platter, and reduced overall HDD opacity.
